q1: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2: SELECT F1.FOLLOWER, COUNT(DISTINCT F2.FOLLOWER) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW F1 JOIN FOLLOW F2 ON F1.FOLLOWER = F2.FOLLOWEE GROUP BY F1.FOLLOWER HAVING NUM >=1
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT F1.FOLLOWER, COUNT(DISTINCT F2.FOLLOWER) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW F1 JOIN FOLLOW F2 ON F1.FOLLOWER = F2.FOLLOWEE GROUP BY F1.FOLLOWER HAVING NUM >=1
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent. Q1 counts the number of followers for each user who is being followed by at least one user, while Q2 counts the number of distinct followers for each user who is following at least one user.
counterexample_dsp: A user A who is being followed by user B, and user C who is following user A.
